note: Live-session recording of the screen scenes (series/tools/rec). prepare/teardown run on the laptop, not recorded; commands are typed and run for real. Screens that mix a terminal and a portal carry the second half in also[] (when = before/after the main part). Scenes read MG_LAB_ADMIN_UPN / MG_LAB_DOMAIN (set by prepare, derived from the signed-in labadmin).
prepare: Connect-MgGraph -Scopes Group.ReadWrite.All, GroupMember.ReadWrite.All, Tasks.ReadWrite, User.ReadBasic.All, User.Read.All -NoWelcome  # owner signs in (browser)

$gs = (Invoke-MgGraphRequest -Uri "/v1.0/groups?`$filter=groupTypes/any(c:c eq 'Unified')&`$select=id,displayName&`$top=999").value | Where-Object displayName -match '^(TEAM_.*_)?Project Falcon$' | Select-Object -First 1; if (-not $gs) { throw 'Group Project Falcon not found: recreate it (episode 2) before recording' }; Set-Content (Join-Path $env:TEMP 'mglab-ep15-group.txt') $gs.id; Set-LabVar MG_FALCON_GROUP $gs.id
# labadmin and the four assignees must be MEMBERS of the group (Global Administrator is not enough to create a plan); note who was already a member

foreach ($u in 'sam.demo', 'jordan.demo', 'riley.demo', 'taylor.demo') { $upn = "$u@$env:MG_LAB_DOMAIN"; if ($upn -notin $was) { Invoke-MgGraphRequest -Method POST -Uri "/v1.0/groups/$($gs.id)/members/`$ref" -Body @{ '@odata.id' = "https://graph.microsoft.com/v1.0/users/$(Get-LabUserId $u)" } } }; if ($env:MG_LAB_ADMIN_UPN -notin $was) { Invoke-MgGraphRequest -Method POST -Uri "/v1.0/groups/$($gs.id)/members/`$ref" -Body @{ '@odata.id' = "https://graph.microsoft.com/v1.0/users/$((Invoke-MgGraphRequest -Uri /v1.0/me).id)" } }

foreach ($t in $p.tasks) { if ($t.title -in 'Draft customer announcement', 'Fix the three open blocker bugs') { $t.assignees = @(@($t.assignees) + "alex.demo@$env:MG_LAB_DOMAIN" | Select-Object -Unique) } }; $p | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 10 | Set-Content ./src/plan.lab.json   # Alex now has three tasks in the focus window

steps: Planner for the web: open the plan 'Project Falcon - Launch Readiness'
Board view grouped by bucket: Plan, Build, Launch in that order
Open one card: labels, assignees, due date and checklist
mask: group object id and plan id in the address bar

screens.name: audit
prepare: # off camera: make the plan look like a real week (Planner API with the task etags)
& $set ($tasks | Where-Object title -eq 'Confirm launch date with sponsors') @{ dueDateTime = (Get-Date).AddDays(-5).ToUniversalTime().ToString('yyyy-MM-ddT17:00:00Z') }

& $set ($tasks | Where-Object title -eq 'Freeze the release branch') @{ percentComplete = 100 }   # completed with its checklist left open; 'Retire the old landing page' stays unassigned and without a due date

steps: Open the report in the editor: code ./planner-audit.md
Scroll the findings table; mask UPNs

screens.name: todo
commands: # sign in as alex.demo (delegated: To Do tasks do not support application permissions)

also.account: alex.demo (own profile; the owner signs in)
steps: Microsoft To Do for the web as alex.demo: the list 'Falcon focus' with importance and due dates
Open one task: the linked resource points to Microsoft Planner (note how the due date shows)
Planner as alex.demo: mark 'Confirm launch date with sponsors' complete
To Do: the task is checked off

teardown: Connect-MgGraph -Scopes Tasks.ReadWrite, Group.ReadWrite.All, GroupMember.ReadWrite.All -NoWelcome  # owner signs in as labadmin

$gid = (Get-Content (Join-Path $env:TEMP 'mglab-ep15-group.txt')).Trim(); foreach ($pl in (Invoke-MgGraphRequest -Uri "/v1.0/groups/$gid/planner/plans").value | Where-Object title -eq 'Project Falcon - Launch Readiness') { $e = (Invoke-MgGraphRequest -Uri "/v1.0/planner/plans/$($pl.id)").'@odata.etag'; Invoke-MgGraphRequest -Method DELETE -Uri "/v1.0/planner/plans/$($pl.id)" -Headers @{ 'If-Match' = $e } }

$was = Get-Content (Join-Path $env:TEMP 'mglab-ep15-members.txt'); foreach ($m in (Invoke-MgGraphRequest -Uri "/v1.0/groups/$gid/members?`$select=id,userPrincipalName").value) { if ($m.userPrincipalName -notin $was) { Invoke-MgGraphRequest -Method DELETE -Uri "/v1.0/groups/$gid/members/$($m.id)/`$ref" } }
# by hand: To Do for the web as alex.demo: delete the list 'Falcon focus'; clear the browser profiles' sign-ins
needs: trial:Microsoft 365 E5 (Planner, To Do; basic plans only)
role:labadmin must be a member of the Project Falcon group
owner signs in as alex.demo (delegated) during the todo screen and as labadmin again afterwards
